title: Juliana Gomez exits Asian Games fencing after P-black card

blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Filipino fencer Juliana Gomez reached the round of 16 of the women’s individual epee before her Asian Games run ended on a P-black card against Singapore’s Elle Meihui Koh on Sept. 22 at Aichi Sky Expo Hall F in Japan. Gomez trailed Koh, 3-1, when the direct-elimination bout was stopped for non-combativity, giving the Singaporean a place in the quarterfinals.
